checkinNotifications.deliveryHint: Configure notification channels first. Changes here save automatically. Delivery failures do not affect check-in results.

trustedProxies.label: Trusted Proxies
trustedProxies.description: X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP is accepted only when the TCP peer matches one of these IPs or CIDRs. Changes apply immediately.
trustedProxies.security: Enter only actual reverse proxy addresses; avoid 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.

apiBaseUrl.label: API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL clients use to reach this service. When set, an export button appears in the API key list

responsesWS.label: OpenAI Responses WebSocket
responsesWS.description: Opt-in upstream WebSocket for client WebSocket /v1/responses ingress. "Enabled · Default off" turns the capability on without using it by default (channels can opt in); Passthrough/Transform is the default mode unless overridden per channel.

sseHeartbeat.label: Streaming Keep-alive Interval (seconds)
sseHeartbeat.description: Controls SSE heartbeats and WebSocket Ping during streaming, retries, and between WebSocket turns; 0 disables. 30-60 seconds is recommended behind a reverse proxy.
sseHeartbeat.compatibility: Some clients may mishandle SSE comments, so disable it if compatibility issues occur.

preStreamHeartbeat.label: First Pre-stream Heartbeat Delay (seconds)
preStreamHeartbeat.description: Delay before the first heartbeat while waiting for an upstream SSE stream. Requires streaming keep-alives; 0 disables pre-stream heartbeats. After a heartbeat is sent, HTTP status stays 200 and later errors are returned as SSE events.

nonStreamKeepAlive.label: Non-streaming Keep-alive Interval (seconds)
nonStreamKeepAlive.description: Sends leading whitespace while waiting for JSON responses; 0 disables. After a keep-alive byte is sent, HTTP status stays 200 and later errors remain in the JSON body. Applies to regular requests, images, and compact.

emptyResponseDetection.label: Empty Response Detection
emptyResponseDetection.description: Applies to all groups. When enabled, an upstream 200 response with no meaningful content (text, tool calls, or reasoning) is treated as failed and retried on another channel.

mode.label: Binding mode
mode.description: Prefer allows failover. Strict keeps an existing channel binding even when it fails. Responses continuation recovery remains independent.

source.label: Session identifier
source.description: Auto tries the configured header, session_id, then prompt_cache_key, and falls back to API key scope. An explicit source with no value disables affinity.

channelAffinity.title: Channel Affinity
channelAffinity.description: Remembers the channel and channel key from the latest fully successful request for each API key, group, and requested model, then prefers them on later requests. Responses continuation routing still takes precedence.

enabled.label: Enable Channel Affinity
enabled.description: When disabled, affinity records are neither read nor refreshed and normal load balancing resumes.

ttl.label: Affinity TTL (seconds)
ttl.description: A record expires and normal routing resumes when no successful request refreshes it within this period.

relayBudget.inherit: Use 0 to inherit the global budget. Sends and backoff share one request budget. Routing stops once response content is committed.
relayBudget.title: HTTP/WS Failover Budget
relayBudget.description: Shared limits for each chat or Responses HTTP request or WS response.create, including reconnects and conversation replay. Each WS turn has its own budget.

maxChannels.label: Max Candidate Channels
maxChannels.description: Maximum number of distinct channels receiving an upstream request. Disabled, keyless, and capability-incompatible candidates do not count.

maxAttempts.label: Max Total Upstream Attempts
maxAttempts.description: Maximum number of upstream sends across all channels, including failed sends, reconnect resends, and conversation replay.

timeout.label: Failover Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Bounds the full upstream response for non-stream requests and the time before response commitment for streams. Replay also has a 15-second pre-commit limit. Output already in progress is not truncated by these limits.

circuitBreaker.title: Circuit Breaker
circuitBreaker.hint: When a channel fails consecutively up to the threshold, circuit breaker trips. Cooldown grows exponentially up to the max cooldown
